views.name: vw_points_balance
views.definition:
WITH ledger_balance AS (
         SELECT pt.id_cliente,
            COALESCE(sum(pt.puntos), 0::bigint) AS ledger_points
           FROM points_transactions pt
          GROUP BY pt.id_cliente
        ), pending_expired_cycles AS (
         SELECT pc.id_cliente,
            pc.id_cycle,
            COALESCE(sum(pt.puntos), 0::bigint) AS remaining_points
           FROM points_cycles pc
             JOIN points_transactions pt ON pt.id_cycle = pc.id_cycle
          WHERE pc.estado_ciclo_codigo = 'activo'::text AND pc.vence_at IS NOT NULL AND pc.vence_at <= now()
          GROUP BY pc.id_cliente, pc.id_cycle
        ), pending_expiration_by_client AS (
         SELECT pec.id_cliente,
            COALESCE(sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN pec.remaining_points > 0 THEN pec.remaining_points
                    ELSE 0::bigint
                END), 0::bigint::numeric) AS pending_expired_points
           FROM pending_expired_cycles pec
          GROUP BY pec.id_cliente
        )
 SELECT lb.id_cliente,
    (lb.ledger_points::numeric - COALESCE(pe.pending_expired_points, 0::bigint::numeric))::integer AS balance_puntos
   FROM ledger_balance lb
     LEFT JOIN pending_expiration_by_client pe ON pe.id_cliente = lb.id_cliente;

views.name: vw_points_redemption_services
views.definition:
SELECT prs.id_rule_service,
    pr.id_rule,
    pr.id_sucursal,
    prs.cliente_condicion_codigo,
    prs.id_servicio,
    s.nombre_servicio,
    s.descripcion AS descripcion_servicio,
    s.grupo_catalogo,
    COALESCE(prs.puntos_canje, pr.puntos_para_premio) AS puntos_requeridos,
    prs.puntos_canje AS puntos_canje_override,
    pr.puntos_para_premio AS puntos_para_premio_regla,
    prs.habilitado AS regla_servicio_activa,
    prs.visible_cliente,
    prs.orden_visual,
    pr.activo AS regla_puntos_activa,
    s.activo AS servicio_activo,
    s.visible_publico AS servicio_visible_publico,
    s.agendable AS servicio_agendable,
    prs.created_at,
    prs.updated_at
   FROM points_rule_services prs
     JOIN points_rules pr ON pr.id_rule = prs.id_rule
     JOIN servicios s ON s.id_servicio = prs.id_servicio
  WHERE s.deleted_at IS NULL;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_points_estado_final_cita()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_estado text;
BEGIN
  SELECT ec.estado_cita_codigo
  INTO v_estado
  FROM public.estados_cita ec
  WHERE lower(trim(ec.estado_cita_codigo)) IN ('completada','atendida','finalizada')
  ORDER BY
    CASE lower(trim(ec.estado_cita_codigo))
      WHEN 'completada' THEN 1
      WHEN 'atendida' THEN 2
      WHEN 'finalizada' THEN 3
      ELSE 99
    END
  LIMIT 1;

  IF v_estado IS NULL THEN
    v_estado := 'completada';
  END IF;

  RETURN v_estado;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_points_get_effective_rule(p_id_sucursal uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id_rule uuid, id_sucursal uuid, umbral_monto_hnl numeric, puntos_por_cita integer, puntos_para_premio integer, expiracion_meses integer, activo boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT
    pr.id_rule,
    pr.id_sucursal,
    pr.umbral_monto_hnl,
    pr.puntos_por_cita,
    pr.puntos_para_premio,
    pr.expiracion_meses,
    pr.activo
  FROM public.points_rules pr
  WHERE pr.activo IS TRUE

  ORDER BY

    pr.updated_at DESC,
    pr.created_at DESC,
    pr.id_rule DESC
  LIMIT 1
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_points_materialize_expired_cycles(p_id_cliente uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_cycle record;
  v_balance integer;
  v_total integer := 0;
BEGIN
  FOR v_cycle IN
    SELECT
      pc.id_cycle,
      pc.id_cliente,
      pc.vence_at
    FROM public.points_cycles pc
    WHERE pc.estado_ciclo_codigo = 'activo'
      AND pc.vence_at <= now()
      AND (p_id_cliente IS NULL OR pc.id_cliente = p_id_cliente)
    ORDER BY pc.id_cycle
    FOR UPDATE OF pc
  LOOP
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pt.puntos), 0)::integer
      INTO v_balance
    FROM public.points_transactions pt
    WHERE pt.id_cycle = v_cycle.id_cycle;

    IF v_balance > 0 THEN
      INSERT INTO public.points_transactions (
        id_cliente,
        id_cycle,
        tipo_puntos_codigo,
        puntos,
        vence_at,
        motivo,
        created_at,
        updated_at
      )
      VALUES (
        v_cycle.id_cliente,
        v_cycle.id_cycle,
        'vencimiento',
        v_balance,
        v_cycle.vence_at,
        'Vencimiento automatico del ciclo',
        now(),
        now()
      )
      ON CONFLICT (id_cycle, tipo_puntos_codigo)
        WHERE id_cycle IS NOT NULL
          AND tipo_puntos_codigo = 'vencimiento'
      DO NOTHING;
    END IF;

    UPDATE public.points_cycles
    SET estado_ciclo_codigo = 'expirado',
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE id_cycle = v_cycle.id_cycle
      AND estado_ciclo_codigo = 'activo';

    IF FOUND THEN
      v_total := v_total + 1;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  RETURN v_total;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_trg_otorgar_puntos_por_cita()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_estado_final text;
  v_origen text;
  v_puntos_por_cita integer := 1;
  v_cycle record;
  v_cliente_usuario uuid;
BEGIN
  SELECT public.fn_points_estado_final_cita() INTO v_estado_final;

  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
    IF NEW.estado_cita_codigo IS DISTINCT FROM v_estado_final THEN
      RETURN NEW;
    END IF;
  ELSIF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
    IF NOT (
      OLD.estado_cita_codigo IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.estado_cita_codigo
      AND NEW.estado_cita_codigo = v_estado_final
    ) THEN
      RETURN NEW;
    END IF;
  ELSE
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF NEW.id_cliente IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  v_origen := CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(NEW.orden_integrante, 1) > 1 THEN 'integrante'
    ELSE 'titular'
  END;

  IF COALESCE(NEW.es_canje_recompensa, false) IS TRUE AND v_origen = 'titular' THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(pr.puntos_por_cita, 1)
  INTO v_puntos_por_cita
  FROM public.points_rules pr
  WHERE pr.activo IS TRUE
    AND (pr.id_sucursal = NEW.id_sucursal OR pr.id_sucursal IS NULL)
  ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN pr.id_sucursal = NEW.id_sucursal THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
    pr.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST,
    pr.created_at DESC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 1;

  SELECT *
  INTO v_cycle
  FROM public.fn_points_get_or_create_active_cycle(
    NEW.id_cliente,
    COALESCE(NEW.inicio_at, now())
  )
  LIMIT 1;

  SELECT c.id_usuario
  INTO v_cliente_usuario
  FROM public.clientes c
  WHERE c.id_cliente = NEW.id_cliente
    AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  LIMIT 1;

  INSERT INTO public.points_transactions (
    id_cliente,
    id_cita,
    id_cycle,
    id_sucursal_origen,
    tipo_puntos_codigo,
    origen_punto_codigo,
    puntos,
    vence_at,
    motivo,
    creado_por_usuario_id,
    created_at,
    updated_at
  )
  VALUES (
    NEW.id_cliente,
    NEW.id_cita,
    v_cycle.id_cycle,
    NEW.id_sucursal,
    'acumular',
    v_origen,
    GREATEST(1, COALESCE(v_puntos_por_cita, 1)),
    v_cycle.vence_at,
    CASE WHEN v_origen = 'integrante'
      THEN 'Punto por acompañante en visita completada'
      ELSE 'Punto por visita completada del titular'
    END,
    COALESCE(NEW.creada_por_usuario_id, v_cliente_usuario),
    now(),
    now()
  )
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

  RETURN NEW;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_points_estado_final_cita()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_estado text;
BEGIN
  SELECT ec.estado_cita_codigo
  INTO v_estado
  FROM public.estados_cita ec
  WHERE lower(trim(ec.estado_cita_codigo)) IN ('completada','atendida','finalizada')
  ORDER BY
    CASE lower(trim(ec.estado_cita_codigo))
      WHEN 'completada' THEN 1
      WHEN 'atendida' THEN 2
      WHEN 'finalizada' THEN 3
      ELSE 99
    END
  LIMIT 1;

  IF v_estado IS NULL THEN
    v_estado := 'completada';
  END IF;

  RETURN v_estado;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_points_get_effective_rule(p_id_sucursal uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id_rule uuid, id_sucursal uuid, umbral_monto_hnl numeric, puntos_por_cita integer, puntos_para_premio integer, expiracion_meses integer, activo boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT
    pr.id_rule,
    pr.id_sucursal,
    pr.umbral_monto_hnl,
    pr.puntos_por_cita,
    pr.puntos_para_premio,
    pr.expiracion_meses,
    pr.activo
  FROM public.points_rules pr
  WHERE pr.activo IS TRUE
    AND (pr.id_sucursal = p_id_sucursal OR pr.id_sucursal IS NULL)
  ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN pr.id_sucursal = p_id_sucursal THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
    pr.updated_at DESC,
    pr.created_at DESC,
    pr.id_rule DESC
  LIMIT 1
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_points_materialize_expired_cycles(p_id_cliente uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_cycle record;
  v_balance integer;
  v_total integer := 0;
BEGIN
  FOR v_cycle IN
    SELECT
      pc.id_cycle,
      pc.id_cliente,
      pc.vence_at
    FROM public.points_cycles pc
    WHERE pc.estado_ciclo_codigo = 'activo'
      AND pc.vence_at <= now()
      AND (p_id_cliente IS NULL OR pc.id_cliente = p_id_cliente)
    ORDER BY pc.id_cycle
    FOR UPDATE OF pc
  LOOP
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pt.puntos), 0)::integer
      INTO v_balance
    FROM public.points_transactions pt
    WHERE pt.id_cycle = v_cycle.id_cycle;

    IF v_balance > 0 THEN
      INSERT INTO public.points_transactions (
        id_cliente,
        id_cycle,
        tipo_puntos_codigo,
        puntos,
        vence_at,
        motivo,
        created_at,
        updated_at
      )
      VALUES (
        v_cycle.id_cliente,
        v_cycle.id_cycle,
        'vencimiento',
        v_balance,
        v_cycle.vence_at,
        'Vencimiento automatico del ciclo',
        now(),
        now()
      )
      ON CONFLICT (id_cycle, tipo_puntos_codigo)
        WHERE id_cycle IS NOT NULL
          AND tipo_puntos_codigo = 'vencimiento'
      DO NOTHING;
    END IF;

    UPDATE public.points_cycles
    SET estado_ciclo_codigo = 'expirado',
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE id_cycle = v_cycle.id_cycle
      AND estado_ciclo_codigo = 'activo';

    IF FOUND THEN
      v_total := v_total + 1;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  RETURN v_total;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_trg_otorgar_puntos_por_cita()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_estado_final text;
  v_origen text;
  v_puntos_por_cita integer := 1;
  v_cycle record;
  v_cliente_usuario uuid;
BEGIN
  SELECT public.fn_points_estado_final_cita() INTO v_estado_final;

  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
    IF NEW.estado_cita_codigo IS DISTINCT FROM v_estado_final THEN
      RETURN NEW;
    END IF;
  ELSIF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
    IF NOT (
      OLD.estado_cita_codigo IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.estado_cita_codigo
      AND NEW.estado_cita_codigo = v_estado_final
    ) THEN
      RETURN NEW;
    END IF;
  ELSE
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF NEW.id_cliente IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  v_origen := CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(NEW.orden_integrante, 1) > 1 THEN 'integrante'
    ELSE 'titular'
  END;

  IF COALESCE(NEW.es_canje_recompensa, false) IS TRUE AND v_origen = 'titular' THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(pr.puntos_por_cita, 1)
  INTO v_puntos_por_cita
  FROM public.points_rules pr
  WHERE pr.activo IS TRUE
    AND (pr.id_sucursal = NEW.id_sucursal OR pr.id_sucursal IS NULL)
  ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN pr.id_sucursal = NEW.id_sucursal THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
    pr.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST,
    pr.created_at DESC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 1;

  SELECT *
  INTO v_cycle
  FROM public.fn_points_get_or_create_active_cycle(
    NEW.id_cliente,
    COALESCE(NEW.inicio_at, now())
  )
  LIMIT 1;

  SELECT c.id_usuario
  INTO v_cliente_usuario
  FROM public.clientes c
  WHERE c.id_cliente = NEW.id_cliente
    AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  LIMIT 1;

  INSERT INTO public.points_transactions (
    id_cliente,
    id_cita,
    id_cycle,
    id_sucursal_origen,
    tipo_puntos_codigo,
    origen_punto_codigo,
    puntos,
    vence_at,
    motivo,
    creado_por_usuario_id,
    created_at,
    updated_at
  )
  VALUES (
    NEW.id_cliente,
    NEW.id_cita,
    v_cycle.id_cycle,
    NEW.id_sucursal,
    'acumular',
    v_origen,
    GREATEST(1, COALESCE(v_puntos_por_cita, 1)),
    v_cycle.vence_at,
    CASE WHEN v_origen = 'integrante'
      THEN 'Punto por acompañante en visita completada'
      ELSE 'Punto por visita completada del titular'
    END,
    COALESCE(NEW.creada_por_usuario_id, v_cliente_usuario),
    now(),
    now()
  )
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
